identity.title: IT Director - Healthcare Technology
identity.description: Senior IT leadership role responsible for technology strategy, vendor management, and digital transformation in a HIPAA-regulated healthcare environment. Champions modernisation while ensuring security and compliance.

professionalContext.decision_authority: Has budget authority up to $50K. Needs C-level approval for larger purchases. Influences vendor selection and evaluates technical requirements. Key stakeholder in digital transformation initiatives.

roleBasedNeeds.text: Ensure HIPAA compliance across all systems
Find vendors who understand healthcare compliance requirements

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Legacy systems that are expensive to maintain
roleBasedFrustrations.context: Particularly affecting daily operations and budget planning

roleBasedFrustrations.text: Difficulty finding vendors who understand healthcare compliance
Limited IT budget despite growing technology needs
Pressure to deliver faster while maintaining security

approval_process.criteria: Technical fit, security compliance, and integration requirements
